name: git-workflow
description: PR and issue workflow toolkit with a git desk: a detached local server triages in background and a local page, in the Browser pane beside the chat or in the browser, lists the PRs whose next move is yours, ready for pr-loop, the issues into to close and for Claude. A mod in this plugin shows the loops at work and a notice when a PR comes to review, naming the desk and who opened it. Every click runs in the attached chat with its command echoed; public actions only there.
